title: Tensorial Reduced-Order Models for Parametric Coupled Reaction-Diffusion Systems: Application to Brain Tumor Growth Modeling
summary: We construct efficient surrogate models for parametric forward operators arising in brain tumor growth simulations, governed by coupled semilinear parabolic reaction-diffusion systems on heterogeneous two- and three-dimensional domains. We consider two models of increasing complexity: a scalar single-species formulation and a six-state, nine-parameter multi-species go-or-grow model. The governing equations are discretized using a finite volume method and integrated in time via an operator-splitting strategy.
